_comment: Pockethost OblivionMP release candidate; see README for validation status.
name: OblivionMP
author: operations@pockethost.cloud
description: Oblivion Remastered multiplayer by ReadyM. Linux x64 server 1.0.0-rc.2 with bundled SDK and mods. Beta software; requires the ReadyM Launcher.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

# This release's SDK and bundled mods must be installed together.
readonly RELEASE_URL='https://readycodestorage.blob.core.windows.net/oblivion-server-releases/oblivion-server-linux64-1.0.0-rc.2.zip'
readonly RELEASE_SHA256='a14f73b5352e6acf5f4813f2c1a10a255d2789f564b6e7fe33fb15bbff92957a'

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
staging=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$staging"' EXIT
curl --fail --location --show-error --silent "$RELEASE_URL" -o "$staging/server.zip"
printf '%s  %s\n' "$RELEASE_SHA256" "$staging/server.zip" | sha256sum --check --status
unzip -tq "$staging/server.zip"

# Restore release-owned files without deleting custom mods or persistent state.
# The bundled mod folders belong to this release; put custom mods in other folders.
unzip -oq "$staging/server.zip" -d /mnt/server -x config.json 'saves/*' 'data/*'
if [ ! -e config.json ]; then
    unzip -p "$staging/server.zip" config.json > config.json
fi
mkdir -p saves data
chmod 755 server
printf '%s\n' 'OblivionMP 1.0.0-rc.2 installed.'

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the ReadyM Launcher.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional join password. Empty permits joining without a password.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Connection limit. Capacity must be measured before raising this limit.

variables.name: Public Listing
variables.description: Set true to list in ReadyM. Configure Public Host before enabling.

variables.name: Public Host
variables.description: Publicly routable IP or hostname for this allocation. Do not use a container or private address.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Listing label only; this does not install a game mode.

variables.name: Description
variables.description: Optional description shown in the Launcher.

variables.name: Country
variables.description: Optional two-letter uppercase country code, such as DE.

variables.name: Verification License
variables.description: Optional ReadyM verification key. Treat it as a secret; it is not required for an unverified listing.

variables.name: Telemetry Opt Out
variables.description: Set true to disable anonymous ReadyM telemetry.
